 We are seeking a highly motivated software development engineer in test (SDET). The ideal candidate is passionate about developing high\-quality, robust, optimized, and reusable software infrastructure, and is eager to advance their skills in complex systems thinking and validation problem\-solving.

* Develop and maintain dashboards to illustrate progress against targets and highlight focus areas.
* Execute, triage, and debug automated verification and validation system tests.

* Experience developing automated test frameworks and tools for HIL and/or SIL.
* Experience designing and developing automated dashboards using data visualization tools such as Grafana or Looker to monitor operational metrics.
* Object\-oriented programming experience in Python
* Experience executing and debugging automated tests, preferably with embedded systems or Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience building tools and automation for verification and validation teams.
* Experience building web\-apps with streamlit.
* Experience with CI and build systems (e.g. Bamboo, Buildkite, etc.)
* Experience with the incorporation of AI technology into end\-to\-end test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and productivity.
* Familiarity working with APIs in Jira, Polarion, Testrail and other similar tools.

About Vercel:
   

  

 Vercel gives developers the tools and cloud infrastructure to build, scale, and secure a faster, more personalized web. As the team behind v0, Next.js, and AI SDK, Vercel helps customers like Ramp, Supreme, PayPal, and Under Armour build for the AI\-native web.
   

  

 Our mission is to enable the world to ship the best products. That starts with creating a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, supporting our customers, or shaping our story: You can just ship things.
   

  

 We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user. You'll own the core surface through which developers and teams interact with Vercel, from first login through daily use.
   

  

 The Dashboard is where the self\-driving aspect of Vercel's Cloud comes to life. Today, it's a project listing page. We're turning it into a personalized, agent\-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and stay on best practices. This is a foundational role: you'll be one of the first engineers on a new team, working alongside our current tech lead to rearchitect and rebuild the Dashboard from the ground up.
   

  

 You'll work across the stack: building fast, polished UI on the frontend and the APIs, data layers, and services that power personalization, agent experiences, and real\-time push surfaces on the backend. The Dashboard must be the reference implementation of Vercel's own platform.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and own core Dashboard infrastructure: the shell, navigation, layout system, and shared components that every product area builds within
* Architect and implement the backend services and APIs that power the Dashboard, including personalization, notifications, and agent\-powered experiences
* Drive performance as a core feature. Profile, measure, and optimize aggressively. Every interaction should feel instant
* Build agent\-facing surfaces: the UI and API layers where agents surface errors, suggest fixes, update config, and keep users on best practices
* Work closely with product area teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability, etc.) to ensure their pages integrate cleanly into the Dashboard shell and follow shared patterns
* Ship incrementally and continuously. This is a living product that improves every week


**About You**
* 4\+ years of experience as a software engineer building user\-facing products. You're strong across the stack: modern frontend (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and backend (APIs, databases, services)
* You've built products for developers or technical users. You understand the expectations of this audience and you hold yourself to the same bar
* You think in systems. You naturally build reusable abstractions, composable components, and clean APIs rather than one\-off solutions
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. This is a new team building a new product direction. You can take a rough problem statement and turn it into shipped code
* You use AI tools in your own development workflow and have opinions on how they should work
* You ship fast without sacrificing quality. You bias toward iteration and production feedback over long planning cycles
* You communicate clearly and collaborate well with Product, Design, and other engineering teams


**Bonus**
* Experience working on platform or horizontal teams where you built shared infrastructure that other teams depended on
* Contributions to open source projects, especially in the React or Next.js ecosystem


 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000\-$294,000\. Actual salary will be based on job\-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.
   

  

 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.
